versions.text:
1. The representation of Smt. A. Lakshmi Prasanna, Senior Assistant, Regional Office, Guntur, is placed at PUC (Flag A). She has requested transfer to Regional Office, Vijayawada on spouse grounds, as her husband is working as Junior Assistant in the Commercial Taxes Department at Vijayawada.
2. The request has been received during the period of relaxation of the ban on transfers (08-06-2022 to 30-06-2022) prescribed in G.O.Ms.No.88, Finance (HR.I-Plg. & Policy) Department, Dt.03-06-2022 (Flag B).
3. As verified, (a) she has completed 3 years 4 months at Guntur; (b) 9 transfers have been effected in the Senior Assistant category against a cadre strength of 112, i.e. 8.0%, within the 20% ceiling; (c) the Vigilance section has reported that no enquiry is pending against her; and (d) one clear vacancy of Senior Assistant exists at Vijayawada.
4. Para 2(v) of the G.O. at Flag B provides that spouse cases shall be given preference subject to availability of vacancy. The request satisfies the conditions.
5. If approved, draft transfer orders are put up for approval (DFA).
8. Recommended for approval. Submitted to Secretary.

1. Sri M. Ravi Teja, Junior Assistant, Regional Office, Ongole, has requested transfer to Regional Office, Nellore on spouse grounds (PUC at Flag A). His wife is working as a teacher in a Zilla Parishad High School near Nellore.
2. The request has been received on 21-08-2023, outside the period of relaxation of the ban on transfers (08-06-2022 to 30-06-2022) under G.O.Ms.No.88, Finance (HR.I-Plg. & Policy) Department, Dt.03-06-2022. No orders relaxing the ban for 2023 have been issued by the Finance Department.
3. As per para (e) of Standing Order No.2/2020 of this Department (Flag B), requests received outside the period of relaxation shall be kept pending for consideration during the next general transfers.
4. It is therefore proposed that the individual may be informed that his request will be considered during the next general transfers.
7. The ban is in force. Submitted for orders.
8. Not agreed at present, as the ban on transfers is in force. Inform the individual accordingly.

1. Smt. P. Sandhya Rani, Senior Assistant, Regional Office, Kakinada, has requested transfer to Regional Office, Rajahmundry on spouse grounds (Flag A). Her husband is a Senior Assistant in the Revenue Department at Rajahmundry.
2. The request is within the period of relaxation (15-05-2025 to 31-05-2025) under G.O.Ms.No.31, Finance (HR.I-Plg. & Policy) Department, Dt.12-05-2025 (Flag B).
3. As verified, (a) station period 4 years 1 month; (b) 14 transfers effected in the Senior Assistant category against a cadre strength of 120, i.e. 11.7%, within the 15% ceiling; (c) Vigilance clearance obtained — no enquiry pending; (d) one clear vacancy exists at Rajahmundry.
4. The request is covered by para 2(v) of the G.O. at Flag B. If approved, DFA is put up.

1. Sri K. Venkata Ramana, Superintendent, Regional Office, Tirupati, has requested transfer to Regional Office, Kurnool on spouse grounds (Flag A).
2. The request is within the period of relaxation under G.O.Ms.No.31, Finance (HR.I-Plg. & Policy) Department, Dt.12-05-2025.
3. On reference, the Vigilance section has informed (Flag B) that a preliminary enquiry is pending against the individual in file No.USD01-31/4/2025-VIG relating to the evaluation of tenders for drain works in 2024.
4. Para 2(vii) of G.O.Ms.No.31 and Circular Memo No.GAD01-SERA0/3/2023, Dt.14-08-2023 provide that requests of employees against whom disciplinary proceedings are pending or contemplated shall not be considered until their conclusion.
5. It is proposed that the request may not be considered at present.
8. Not considered in view of the pending enquiry.

1. A complaint has been received (Flag A) alleging that the technical evaluation of three tenders for drain works in 2024 was manipulated to favour a single contractor.
2. The complaint names Sri K. Venkata Ramana, Superintendent, who was then working in the Works section and dealt with the tender files.
3. It is proposed that a preliminary enquiry may be ordered and the Superintending Engineer (Vigilance) may be appointed as Enquiry Officer, with a report within 60 days.
5. Approved. Order preliminary enquiry. Keep the file confidential.

1. The Commissioner, Urban Services, has informed (Flag A) that he has accorded administrative sanction for Rs.1.20 crore for emergency restoration of the collapsed drain at Gandhi Nagar, Seetharampuram Municipal Corporation, in exercise of the powers under Circular Memo No.USD01-WRKS0/9/2023, Dt.11-07-2023.
2. The sanction is within the limit of Rs.1.50 crore prescribed in the said Circular Memo. The matter is placed for information.

1. The Commissioner, Urban Services, has submitted proposals (Flag A) for emergency restoration of a culvert and approach road at Ward No.6, Seetharampuram Municipal Corporation, damaged in the floods of September 2024, at an estimated cost of Rs.1.40 crore.
2. As per para 2(vi) of G.O.Ms.No.27, Urban Services (Works) Department, Dt.06-08-2024 (Flag B), works including emergency works costing above Rs.1.00 crore are to be sanctioned by the Government only. The cost is below Rs.5.00 crore and hence the concurrence of the Finance Department is not required.
3. It is proposed that administrative sanction for Rs.1.40 crore may be accorded by the Government. DFA (G.O.Rt.) is put up.

1. Sri Ch. Naveen Kumar, Senior Assistant, Regional Office, Eluru, has requested transfer to Regional Office, Vijayawada on spouse grounds (Flag A), as his wife is working as Junior Assistant in the School Education Department at Vijayawada. The request was received on 15-09-2026.
2. As per para 2(v) of G.O.Ms.No.88, Finance (HR.I-Plg. & Policy) Department, Dt.03-06-2022 (Flag B), spouse cases shall be given preference subject to availability of vacancy. Further, as per G.O.Ms.No.104, Finance (HR.I) Department, Dt.02-01-2026, spouse cases may be considered at any time during the year.
3. As verified, (a) the station period of the individual is 3 years 2 months; (b) 18 transfers have already been effected in the Senior Assistant category against a cadre strength of 120, i.e. 15%, and the present proposal would take it to 19 (15.8%); (c) one vacancy exists at Vijayawada.
4. Though the ceiling is slightly exceeded, the request may be approved as a special case on humanitarian grounds.
5. As the Secretary is on leave, the Deputy Secretary may kindly approve the transfer, and draft orders are put up for approval (DFA).

1. The Commissioner, Urban Services, has submitted (Flag A) that a storm water drain at Ward No.21, Seetharampuram Municipal Corporation was breached in the heavy rains of 18-09-2026, and has proposed to accord administrative sanction for Rs.1.30 crore for emergency restoration.
2. As per Circular Memo No.USD01-WRKS0/9/2023, Dt.11-07-2023 (Flag B), the Commissioner may accord administrative sanction for emergency works up to Rs.1.50 crore per work. The proposed cost is within this limit.
3. It is therefore proposed that the Commissioner may be permitted to accord the sanction, and the same may be reported to the Government in the monthly statement.

1. Fourteen Data Entry Operators are working in the Department and its Regional Offices on outsourcing basis through the agency engaged by the Department.
2. Government, in G.O.Rt.No.1184, Finance (HR.I) Department, Dt.21-03-2025 (Flag A), have permitted continuation of outsourcing services. Accordingly, it is proposed to continue the services of the 14 Data Entry Operators from 01-04-2026 to 31-03-2027 on the same terms.
3. Since the continuation is on the same terms, reference to the Finance Department may not be necessary. Orders may be issued by the Department.
